name: Clever Engineer
body:
You are quite skilled at your craft and your work is surprisingly sturdy.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus in any Craft or Profession skill.

Benefit: Whenever you produce an item with a Craft or Profession skill which has a break DC, Hit Points, or Disable Device DC, those values increase by +2. For example if you have Craft (woodworking), a strong wooden door you produced would have a break DC of 25 and 22 hit points. When you reach 10 ranks in a Craft or Profession skill these bonuses increase to +4 when made using those skills.
